errors.text_span: ranging from approximately 35% to 95%, with tick labels spaced approximately every 5 percentage points
errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown on the chart is 40% to 100%, not 35% to 95%. The tick labels are spaced every 10 percentage points (40, 50, 60, etc.), not 5.

errors.text_span: reaching a peak of approximately 92% at Epoch 20
errors.evidence: The training line continues to rise after epoch 20, reaching a true peak of 100% around epoch 27.
The line representing validation accuracy is a solid green line, not a dashed one.
The green validation line starts at approximately 45% at Epoch 0, not 60%.

errors.text_span: reaching a maximum of approximately 80% at Epoch 15, subsequently declining to approximately 75% at Epoch 30
errors.evidence: This description of the validation line's trajectory is completely wrong. At Epoch 15, the value is approximately 60%, not a maximum of 80%. The line then rises steadily to a maximum of about 82.5% at the end of the plotted data (around epoch 29); it does not decline.
